page_topic_one_liner: AI inference platforms — GPU scheduling, vLLM/SGLang engines, serverless vs dedicated deployment, and multi-cloud orchestration at production scale
differentiator_vs_generic: This is production inference infrastructure comparison, NOT model training or generic cloud hosting. Hero must show an inference pipeline — API request → GPU cluster → token stream with latency/throughput metrics — NOT a chat UI or training loss curve.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Inference pipeline diagram — incoming API request chip on left, GPU rack cluster block in center with vLLM/SGLang engine label blur, streaming token output on right with tok/s and TTFT metric badges (50–150ms, 840 tok/s blurs)
Secondary: multi-cloud node constellation — 4 provider cloud icons (generic, no real logos) connected by routing arrows to single endpoint
Tertiary: serverless vs dedicated tier split bar — elastic scale-to-zero left half vs fixed GPU instance right half
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is infra not conversation)
Training loss curve or fine-tuning UI
Generic server rack without token-stream output
